correctness.rationale: Seven-step full proof: logistic Fourier multiplier gives the critical normal circle and norm 2; one-sided Mellin/Laplace model gives the Hardy Fredholm disk and interior index +1; an explicit integrable kernel gives Hilbert–Schmidt equivalence precisely below gamma=1; the exact first-order eigenfunction ODE excludes exterior eigenvalues, and index zero plus injectivity yields an inverse; local zero-scale tests prove the sharp norm; weakly-null endpoint boundary layers prove exact essential-norm gap 2, while dominated convergence yields strong convergence; supercritical endpoint dilation proves unboundedness. Digamma HS formula was checked against direct quadrature. A packaged verification program passed 54 finite numerical checks, which are explicitly not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural interpolation between the ordinary Hardy average and the recently introduced normal real-variable Cesàro operator is completely classified. The spectrum changes from a disk filled with eigenvalues to its boundary circle while Fredholm essential spectra remain identical and the interior index drops from +1 to zero. The distance to the critical operator is exactly 2 even modulo compact operators, despite strong convergence: this precise boundary-layer discontinuity is mathematically motivated and goes beyond a routine restatement of endpoint norm or stability theory. The exact digamma Hilbert–Schmidt parameterization complements the sharp critical boundary.
